title: Câu điều kiện hỗn hợp
summary: Trộn loại 2 và loại 3: quá khứ ảnh hưởng hiện tại (If I had…, I would be…) hoặc tính cách hiện tại ảnh hưởng quá khứ.

dialogue.vi: Hôm nay trông bạn mệt thế.

dialogue.en: [[If I had gone]] to bed earlier, I [[wouldn't be]] so tired now.
dialogue.vi: Nếu tối qua ngủ sớm hơn thì giờ mình không mệt thế này.

dialogue.en: I was studying. [[If I were]] smarter, I [[would have finished]] sooner.
dialogue.vi: Mình học bài. Nếu mình thông minh hơn thì đã xong sớm hơn.

dialogue.en: Don't say that! You passed the last test.
dialogue.vi: Đừng nói thế! Bạn qua bài kiểm tra trước mà.

dialogue.en: True. [[If I hadn't passed]] it, I [[would be]] in trouble now.
dialogue.vi: Đúng. Nếu không qua thì giờ mình gặp rắc rối rồi.

sections.heading: If + had V3, would + V
sections.rule: Một việc **trong quá khứ** (không có thật) gây **kết quả ở hiện tại**: **If + had + V3, S + would + V**.

examples.en: [[If I had taken]] the job, I [[would live]] in Hanoi now.
examples.vi: Nếu hồi đó nhận việc thì giờ tôi đang sống ở Hà Nội.
examples.why: Quá khứ (had taken) → hiện tại (would live now).

examples.en: [[If she hadn't missed]] the bus, she [[would be]] here.
examples.vi: Nếu cô ấy không lỡ xe buýt thì giờ đã ở đây.
examples.why: Lỡ xe (quá khứ) → không ở đây (hiện tại).

examples.en: We [[would have]] more money [[if we hadn't bought]] that car.
examples.vi: Nếu không mua chiếc xe đó thì giờ chúng tôi có nhiều tiền hơn.
examples.why: Mệnh đề if đứng sau cũng được.

check.prompt: If I had studied medicine, I ___ a doctor now.
check.explain: Kết quả ở hiện tại (now) → would be.

sections.heading: If + V2, would have + V3
sections.rule: Một **sự thật lâu dài ở hiện tại** (tính cách, khả năng) giải thích **việc trong quá khứ**: **If + V2/were, S + would have + V3**.

formula.text: If + S + V2 / [were], S + [would have] + V3

examples.en: [[If I were]] braver, I [[would have spoken]] to her.
examples.vi: Nếu tôi dạn dĩ hơn thì đã bắt chuyện với cô ấy rồi.
examples.why: Tính cách hiện tại → việc quá khứ.

examples.en: [[If he spoke]] English, he [[would have got]] the job.
examples.vi: Nếu anh ấy biết tiếng Anh thì đã được nhận việc.
examples.why: Khả năng hiện tại → kết quả quá khứ.

check.prompt: If she ___ so shy, she would have joined the club.
check.explain: Tính cách hiện tại → If + weren't.

sections.heading: Chọn đúng loại
sections.rule: Hỏi hai câu: **điều kiện** thuộc lúc nào (quá khứ / luôn đúng)? **kết quả** thuộc lúc nào (bây giờ / quá khứ)?

head: Điều kiện → Kết quả
Mẫu
rows: If I had left, I would have caught it.
If I had left, I would be there now.
If I were rich, I would have bought it.

examples.en: [[If I had saved]] money, I [[would have bought]] a car last year.
examples.vi: Nếu tôi tiết kiệm thì năm ngoái đã mua xe rồi.

examples.en: [[If I had saved]] money, I [[would have]] a car now.
examples.vi: Nếu tôi tiết kiệm thì giờ đã có xe.
examples.why: Quá khứ → bây giờ: hỗn hợp.

check.prompt: If I hadn't eaten so much, I ___ sick now.

mistakes.wrong: If I had took the train, I would be home now.
mistakes.right: If I had taken the train, I would be home now.

mistakes.wrong: If I would have taken the job, I would be rich now.
mistakes.right: If I had taken the job, I would be rich now.
mistakes.why: Không dùng would trong mệnh đề if.

mistakes.wrong: If she had left earlier, she would have been here now.
mistakes.right: If she had left earlier, she would be here now.

mistakes.wrong: If I was more patient, I would have waited for him.
mistakes.right: If I were more patient, I would have waited for him.

mistakes.wrong: If he hadn't lost his job, he will be happier now.
mistakes.right: If he hadn't lost his job, he would be happier now.
mistakes.why: Kết quả giả định → would, không dùng will.

exercises.prompt: If I had listened to you, I ___ in this mess now.
exercises.explain: Quá khứ → hiện tại: wouldn't be.

exercises.prompt: If he ___ so lazy, he would have finished the work.
exercises.explain: Tính cách hiện tại → If + weren't.

exercises.prompt: If we had booked earlier, we ___ better seats now.
exercises.explain: Kết quả bây giờ → would have.

exercises.prompt: Câu nào nói kết quả ở HIỆN TẠI?
options: If I had learned Chinese, I would have got that job.
If I had learned Chinese, I would work in Shanghai now.

exercises.prompt: If I ___ afraid of heights, I would have climbed the tower.
exercises.explain: Tính cách lâu dài → If + weren't.

exercises.prompt: If she ___ the train, she would be here now.
answers: hadn't missed
had not missed
exercises.explain: Quá khứ → hiện tại: If + hadn't + V3.

exercises.prompt: If I were more organized, I ___ my keys yesterday.
answers: wouldn't have lost
would not have lost
exercises.explain: Tính cách hiện tại → would have + V3.

exercises.prompt: If we had planted trees ten years ago, we ___ shade now.
answers: would have
exercises.explain: Kết quả bây giờ → would + V.

exercises.prompt: If he ___ French, he would have understood the film.
answers: spoke
exercises.explain: Khả năng hiện tại → If + V2.

exercises.vi: Nếu tôi nhận việc đó thì giờ tôi đang sống ở Đà Nẵng.
Nếu cô ấy không nhút nhát thì đã nói chuyện với anh ấy rồi.
exercises.explain: Tính cách hiện tại → việc quá khứ.

exercises.sentence: If I would have known, I would be there now.
answers: If I had known, I would be there now.
exercises.explain: Không dùng would trong mệnh đề if.

exercises.sentence: If he had saved money, he would have a house last year.
answers: If he had saved money, he would have had a house last year.
exercises.explain: Kết quả quá khứ (last year) → would have had.

exercises.sentence: If you hadn't helped me, I will still be lost now.
answers: If you hadn't helped me, I would still be lost now.

exercises.vi: Nếu tôi không đi muộn thì giờ tôi đã ở văn phòng rồi.
answers: If I hadn't been late, I would be at the office now.
If I hadn't left late, I would be at the office now.
If I had not been late, I would be in the office now.
If I hadn't been late, I would be in the office now.
If I hadn't left late, I would be in the office now.
If I had not been late, I would be at the office now.

exercises.vi: Nếu tôi giàu thì đã mua căn nhà đó rồi.
answers: If I were rich, I would have bought that house.
If I was rich, I would have bought that house.
If I were rich, I'd have bought that house.
If I had been rich, I would have bought that house.
If I were rich, I would have bought the house.
